# cloudxino_container_host_plans (Data Source)

The Managed Container Service plans a new `cloudxino_container_host` can use, cheapest first, with monthly prices in BDT.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The plans a container host can use, cheapest first, with monthly prices in BDT.
data "cloudxino_container_host_plans" "all" {}

output "cheapest_plan" {
  value = data.cloudxino_container_host_plans.all.plans[0].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether new hosts can be ordered right now.
- `plans` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number)
- `disk_gb` (Number)
- `fee_per_month` (Number) The management fee (BDT).
- `memory_gb` (Number)
- `nat_per_month` (Number) Server plus fee for a NAT host (`ip_type = "nat"`, no public IP) (BDT); 0 when the API does not say.
- `per_hour` (Number) Server plus fee per hour (BDT).
- `per_month` (Number) Server plus fee (BDT).
- `server_per_month` (Number) The server's price (BDT).
- `slug` (String) The value for `plan`, e.g. `s-2vcpu-4gb`.
